sps_hunter_roost.accept_text: East along my trap line, toward the Decrepit Ferry. They sit ahead of me and take the kills - and the traps.

sps_pond_edge.accept_text: The whole edge of Olivia's Pond, the far west bank included. Tell me where it is wet that should not be.

sps_shut_gate.accept_text: The great gate of the Greymane Wall, south-east of my post. Look properly - and tell me what you see, not what is in the log.

sps_amber_waygate.accept_text: The waygate below the tower, south-east of the mill. Describe it to me. Don't speculate. Don't touch it.

sps_road_south.accept_text: South-east from Pyrewood, along under the Greymane Wall, to where the blight stops. Then down the road into Hillsbrad.

sps_deathguard_captain.turn_in_text:
[Dallow is quiet a long time.]

That man held this ground when holding it meant something, and he never got the order to stop.

I'm going to write that down and send it up, and some clerk in the Undercity is going to file it, and that's the whole of what any of us get.

sps_talon_stalkers.turn_in_text: Set six lines this afternoon. And you're right about the crest - you can see the whole keep road from up there. I'd forgotten that was the reason anybody ever cared about this hill.
